verdict.rationale: Ramp's documented capture-to-approval pipeline (OCR receipt capture, auto-coding/memo suggestions, 2/3-way matching, anomaly/fraud flagging, real-time policy checks and recommended approve/reject actions) directly matches the story, and this is corroborated by an independent product page and Ramp Intelligence docs describing agents that 'scan transactions in real-time for anomalies' and 'flag anything unclear or risky.' Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on audit of actual fraud-catch accuracy or false-positive rates beyond vendor claims.
